description: This file implements the GstGenericPlayer class, which manages GStreamer pipeline setup, media data handling, playback control, and resource management for a media player component within the Rialto server project. It includes factory methods for creating instances, pipeline initialization, media segment processing, and various playback controls.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayer
classes.description: Main class managing GStreamer pipeline, media data, and playback controls within the Rialto server media player component.

methods.name: initMsePipeline
methods.description: Initializes the media source extension (MSE) pipeline with a playbin element and configures necessary signals and properties.

methods.name: resetWorkerThread
methods.description: Enqueues a shutdown task, joins, and resets the worker thread used for media processing.

methods.name: termPipeline
methods.description: Cleans up and unreferences all GStreamer elements and buffers, and stops the pipeline.

methods.name: getGstPlayFlag
methods.description: Retrieves specific play flags for the pipeline based on a given nickname.

methods.name: setupSource
methods.description: Callback to set up media source element when added to the pipeline.

methods.name: setupElement
methods.description: Callback for when a new element is added to the pipeline, used to enqueue setup tasks.

methods.name: deepElementAdded
methods.description: Callback for deep element addition within the pipeline, enqueuing appropriate tasks.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Enqueues a task to attach a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Enqueues a task to remove a media source from the pipeline.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Enqueues a task indicating all sources are attached.

methods.name: attachSamples
methods.description: Enqueues a task to attach media segments to the pipeline.

methods.name: attachSamples (overload)
methods.description: Enqueues a task to attach media data from a shared memory reader.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set the playback position.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Enqueues a task to change the playback rate.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Queries the current position of the pipeline if in a suitable state.

methods.name: createBuffer
methods.description: Creates a GstBuffer from a media segment, including handling encryption metadata.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notifies the client that media data is needed for audio or video streams.

methods.name: attachAudioData
methods.description: Pushes accumulated audio buffers into the pipeline's appsrc when needed.

methods.name: attachVideoData
methods.description: Pushes accumulated video buffers into the pipeline's appsrc when needed.

methods.name: updateAudioCaps
methods.description: Updates the audio stream caps with new parameters such as rate and channels.

methods.name: updateVideoCaps
methods.description: Updates the video stream caps with new parameters such as width, height, and framerate.

methods.name: setCodecData
methods.description: Sets codec-specific data into caps, either as buffer or string.

methods.name: scheduleNeedMediaData
methods.description: Schedules a task to request more media data from the client.

methods.name: scheduleEnoughData
methods.description: Schedules a task indicating enough media data has been received.

methods.name: scheduleAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle audio underflow conditions.

methods.name: scheduleVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle video underflow conditions.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Enqueues a task to start playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Enqueues a task to pause playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Enqueues a task to stop playback.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Attempts to change the pipeline's state and notifies the client on failure.

methods.name: setVideoGeometry
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set the video display geometry.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Enqueues a task to signal end-of-stream for a media source.

methods.name: setWesterossinkRectangle
methods.description: Sets the rectangle property on the Westerossink element if available.

methods.name: setWesterossinkSecondaryVideo
methods.description: Configures the Westerossink element for secondary video display if available.

methods.name: startPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Starts a periodic timer for reporting position and checking audio underflow.

methods.name: stopPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Stops the position reporting and underflow check timer.

methods.name: stopWorkerThread
methods.description: Stops the worker thread processing.

methods.name: setPendingPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate to a pending value.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Enqueues a task to render a video frame.
